head: Generalist engineer, leaning ML
bio: I build software end to end: a billing platform at SpryPoint, ice segmentation research at Dalhousie, and ML tools that got measured. Graduating May 2027, open to new grad roles across CS.

shortVersion.rest: Scala and Java back end, Knockout.js front end, on a billing platform for municipal utilities. About 20 client-facing stories delivered.
Trains U-Net models on Landsat-8 imagery of West Greenland and builds the patch datasets the team trains against. Honours study on backdoor attacks in vision models.
Secured $1,500+ in grants across two terms for a society of 150+ members.
